property_summary: For any caller and any _keeper argument, calling setKeeper(_keeper) on the correct contract sets keeper to the provided _keeper (and emits KeeperUpdated with that new keeper); the mutant instead sets keeper to the caller, so there exist inputs where keeper() != the supplied _keeper.
change_summary: Modify setKeeper so it sets keeper to msg.sender rather than the provided _keeper (and keeps onlyOwner restriction removed).
